form.div:
Best use: Route a customer request to the correct operational owner.
Features: Support ticket or qualified commercial request, subject, details, team, value, and expected closing date.
Priority: Use Helpdesk for service issues and CRM only for a real commercial request. Write enough context so the receiving team can act without asking the customer to repeat it.

button.name: action_submit
button.help: Create the selected record from the customer request: a Helpdesk ticket for support, or a CRM opportunity for a qualified commercial request. Review the subject, details, routing team, and expected value first.
Close this window without creating a ticket or opportunity. Information entered here will not be saved.
